notes.title: Banana Girls Roadmap!
notes.content:
[h1]Roadmap![/h1]

Great news for any enjoyer of cute girls! Our roadmap is here!


[h1]Coming Soon![/h1]

With updates planned all the way into December, you can expect -
[olist]
[*] [b]Discord[/b]! Our Discord will be up and running soon, where you will be able to chat with our artist and participate in events to win your own CUSTOM Banana Girl!
[*] [b]Themed Collections! [/b] Watch your collection grow as you unlock more Banana Girls! Will you be able to fill out an entire collection and earn super rare Banana Girls?
[*] [b]Drop Timer![/b] A nice way to keep track of how much time is left until your next Banana Girl ;)
[*] [b]Many cooler updates (and LOTS of awesome ART) coming soon![/b]
[/olist]

More announcements coming soon! Keep collecting banana girls to help them all find a home!
